pre.command: python -m cal.cli verify-health-switch --from v3 --to v4 --mode pre --asof 2026-11-22 --out out/report

post.command: python -m cal.cli verify-health-switch --from v3 --to v4 --mode post --asof 2026-11-22 --actual fixtures/actual.csv --estimate out/report/estimate.csv --out out/report

negative.command: python -m cal.cli verify-health-switch --from v3 --to v4 --mode post --asof 2026-11-22 --actual fixtures/negative_actual.csv --estimate out/report/estimate.csv --out out/negative

scan.command: python scripts/scan_report.py --dir out/report --dir out/negative --dir artifacts --blacklist fixtures/company_names.txt --log out/report/scan.log --exclude artifacts/clean-room --min-files 12
